subject: Invoice intake: portal vs. email — exception playbook & sample field mapping
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@summitpw.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice intake: portal vs. email — exception playbook & sample field mapping

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for signing the activation paperwork — excited to get Summit Paperworks live. We need to lock down the invoice intake path and want to capture a defensible exception/playbook for your team so our AP flows smoothly. Two quick asks: 

1) Which submission channel do you prefer as your primary? (a) vendor portal (preferred for PO visibility), (b) secure email to billing@summitpw.com -> our AP gateway, or (c) SFTP/CSV push.

2) Can you share a representative invoice (PDF or CSV) that includes: PO reference, individual line items with PO line mapping (if you send multiple POs on one invoice), tax breakdowns, and remittance info. If a PDF, great — if you can also export a sample CSV it will speed mapping.

We typically recommend portal-first for high-volume suppliers because it gives PO stamping and idempotency, but we can accept email as a supported exception with a tight subject/attachment convention. If you opt for email, we’ll need a fallback playbook for edge cases (missing PO, multi-PO rows, scanned PDFs).

I’ve attached our onboarding form (short) and a sample mapping doc to speed this up — please return the sample files and we’ll draft the intake mapping and exception rules.

Next steps: if you can send samples by EOD Friday (10/31) we’ll schedule a short call to finalize the mapping.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Onboarding — Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0187

Attachments referenced: redwood_onboarding_form_v2.pdf (onboarding form), mapping_sample_template.xlsx (guidance)
From: Elena Morales <elena@summitpw.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@summitpw.com
Date: 2025-10-29T15:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice intake: portal vs. email — exception playbook & sample field mapping

Jordan,

Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers from Summit Paperworks:

- Primary channel: Email to billing@summitpw.com is our current operational default. We do not have a vendor portal that can push structured CSVs today.
- Secondary channel: We can provide daily CSV exports (SFTP) if you prefer structured ingestion, but that would take ~2 weeks to stand up.
- Sample files: attaching a recent PDF invoice (sample 2109) and a quick CSV export we can produce this week.

Notes on our end: Many of our clients use multi-PO invoices; our billing system populates a single invoice with multiple PO references per line. We can include a PO column for each line, but older scanned PDFs sometimes only list PO numbers in the header.

We’re fine with portal-first from Redwood if that’s the recommendation — we just need clarity on timing and whether portal-only will block payment for invoices that arrive by email in the meantime.

I’ve attached two files: summit_invoice_sample.pdf and summit_invoice_sample.csv (CSV uses UTF-8, comma delimited). We’re open to a short call on Friday morning to walk through edge cases.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Billing — Summit Paperworks
elena@summitpw.com

Attachments: summit_invoice_sample.pdf (PDF of invoice 2109), summit_invoice_sample.csv (CSV export)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@summitpw.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice intake: portal vs. email — exception playbook & sample field mapping

Elena — thanks for the samples, that’s helpful. I reviewed the CSV and the PDF and have a few clarifying asks before we draft the exception playbook: 

- Required fields for email fallback: we require the Subject to include either Redwood PO# or Redwood Contract ID. If the PO is not present on line items, we need it in the invoice header in the first page text. Can you confirm your team can place the primary PO in the invoice header for scanned PDFs?
- Multi-PO rows: your CSV shows a single column named "POs" with semicolon-separated values. We prefer one PO per line (repeated invoice line) or an explicit mapping column named "PO_LINE_REF". Can Summit change the CSV export to have a primary PO column per row?
- Tax & currency: CSV has tax as a single column (tax_total). We need either item-level tax or confirm tax_total applies to the whole invoice and the currency column is always present.

Proposal for intake flow (draft):
- Portal-first for new suppliers onboarding after today.
- Email fallback: accepted but must follow subject pattern "Invoice: <Redwood PO#|ContractID> | <Vendor name>" and include machine-readable attachment (CSV preferred). Scanned PDFs accepted only if header includes PO and PDF OCR confidence >= 80% (we’ll validate).
- Exception playbook: if email arrives without PO, route to manual triage and 72-hour hold queue with AP outreach.

I’ve started a short mapping sheet in the onboarding form link (see related links). If Summit can update the CSV export to include PO per row we can do automatic ingestion. Otherwise we’ll recommend a light-weight SFTP CSV push as the long-term fix.

If that sounds OK I’ll draft the formal playbook and share for sign-off. I’ll also coordinate a 30-minute call Friday 11/2 9:30am PT.

— Jordan

Quick internal note: I support Jordan's proposed hybrid approach — portal-first for onboarding going forward, but email fallback allowed with strict subject conventions and CSV preferred. For Summit specifically, accept their CSV as a temporary ingestion path if they can split PO values to one PO per row within 10 business days.

Karthik — can your team confirm whether our PO-stamping policy requires any changes to accept semicolon-delimited PO columns temporarily? If not, we'll add a mapping rule to split that column during pre-processing.

Thanks — V.

Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Program Manager, Supplier Ops — Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

Date: 2025-10-31T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice intake: portal vs. email — exception playbook & sample field mapping

Thanks Jordan & Vanessa — this works for us. We’ll: 

- Update our daily CSV export to include one PO per row (can deliver the change in ~6 business days).
- Continue sending PDFs to billing@summitpw.com in the meantime, using the subject pattern you specified (we’ll start prepending "Invoice: <Redwood PO#> | Summit Paperworks").
- Attach a CSV where possible; if not available we’ll include a short CSV stub in the same email body as a fallback.

I’ve attached the CSV we’ll push once the change is implemented (summit_invoice_sample.csv). Also proposing a 30-minute handoff call Monday 11/3 10:00am PT to confirm the mapping and test a file.

Elena

Attachments: summit_invoice_sample.csv
